_about: Side quests in the open world (Quests). Every person and line here is original. 'at' is a point on the quest's island in that island's own metres (its clearing is the origin). 'requires' is a story chapter or another quest that must be done first. Types: gather (find 'count' of an item around the island), defeat (waves of foes at 'at'), duel (one named foe at 'at'), deliver (talk to 'to' on another island).

quests.name: Thrown and Forgotten
quests.objective: Find the first-years' practice kunai around Emberwood

intro.text: The first-years threw their practice kunai into the woods. Every last one.
Six are missing. Find them before the head instructor counts the rack.
Six kunai. I'm on it.

outro.text: All six, and not a scratch on them. Better than the first-years manage.

quests.name: Trouble at the Old Pier
quests.objective: Drive the bandits off the south shore

intro.text: Bandits on my pier again. They take the catch and laugh about it.
They camp on the south shore. You're Academy, aren't you? Chase them off.

outro.text: Gone! Come by at dawn some day. The first fish of the morning is yours.

quests.name: Red Leaf Remedy
quests.objective: Gather red-leaf herbs across Autumn Wood

intro.text: Shinobi always come to me bleeding. Today you can help me instead.
Red-leaf grows all over this wood. Five bundles will keep my shelves full.

outro.text: Lovely. Now try not to need any of it.

quests.name: Thieves in the Maples
quests.objective: Stop the herb thieves in the western maples

intro.text: Someone has been stripping the red-leaf before it can grow back.
Wind users, by the cuts. They hide in the maples to the west.

outro.text: The wood will grow back now. So will my patience.

quests.name: The Ash Blade
quests.objective: Defeat Kurogane in a duel

intro.text: So you're the one who walked out of the pass alive.
Stories get told. I'd like to see if this one is true.
Then draw.

outro.text: Ha. True after all. Go on, before I want a second round.

quests.name: Holding Back the Flood
quests.objective: Recover the warding seals torn from the old dam

intro.text: The storm tore the warding seals off the dam and scattered them.
Four of them. Without them, the next storm takes the valley.

outro.text: Every seal back where it belongs. The valley sleeps tonight because of you.

quests.name: A Letter Through the Snow
quests.objective: Carry Renji's letter to Suzu in Autumn Wood

intro.text: My feet won't take me another step on this road. My sister will worry.
She's the healer in Autumn Wood. Would you carry this letter to her?

handover.text: A letter, from your brother on the frozen road.
Renji? That fool. Thank you. I'll send him something warm.

quests.name: The Five Pillars
quests.objective: Answer the five pillars, one nature at a time

intro.text: The pillars still hum. Every nature remembers the fight up here.
Answer them, one by one. Then you'll know what you've become.

outro.text: Five natures, one shinobi. I have nothing left to teach you.

quests.name: Pages on the Wind
quests.objective: Gather the inn's recipe pages the wind scattered over Emberwood

intro.text: A gust took my recipe book clean out of the window. Page by page, over the whole island.
Six pages. My grandmother's broth is on one of them, and I swear I will not remember it without.
Six pages. I'll find them.

outro.text: Every page, and only one with a footprint on it. Broth's on the house, whenever you like.

quests.name: Rowdy Guests
quests.objective: Throw out the rowdy guests at the east path

intro.text: Some drifters took the east path and think the inn owes them dinner. And a wall.
I'd throw them out myself, but I'm holding the ladle. Would you?
Ladle down. I've got this.

outro.text: Not a plate broken. You've a gentler hand than you let on.

quests.name: The Rooftop Dare
quests.objective: Answer Tobi's dare with a proper duel

intro.text: Every year the top graduate gets dared by the next. Asahi dared me once. I lost.
I've been training since. Don't go easy: I'd know.
Wouldn't dream of it.

outro.text: Ow. Good. Next year, I'll be the one doing the daring.

quests.name: Heartwood Amber
quests.objective: Collect amber from the old maples of Autumn Wood

intro.text: Old maples weep amber when the leaves turn. Tree-doctors pay well for it.
Five lumps, from the big ones. My knees say no. Yours say yes.
Five lumps. Going.

outro.text: Clear as honey. The trees owe you, and so do I.

quests.name: The Fallen Bridge
quests.objective: Clear the raiders who have taken the south path

intro.text: Raiders pulled down the footbridge and sit on the south path charging a toll.
Three bands of them by my count. I count badly, though.
I'll bring the toll back, with interest.

outro.text: The path is open again. I'll have the bridge up by autumn's end. Maybe the next one.

quests.name: Medicine for the Snow
quests.objective: Carry Suzu's winter medicine to Renji on the Frozen Road

intro.text: Winter fever on the Frozen Road. Renji's scouts are coughing blood into the snow.
This is the tincture. It must not freeze, and it must not wait.
Not a minute wasted.

handover.text: Suzu's tincture! The scouts will bless you. Quickly, before it chills.

quests.name: Embers at the Shrine
quests.objective: Find the scorched charms scattered over the Ashen Pass

intro.text: When the pass burned, the charms we hung at the shrine flew everywhere, hot as coals.
Five of them. Each one carries somebody's prayer, and I would not have them lost in ash.
I'll bring every prayer home.

outro.text: Singed, but whole. Thank you. The shrine will hold the prayers again.

quests.name: The Last Bell
quests.objective: Drive the scavengers from the shrine bell

intro.text: Scavengers have come for the shrine bell. It is bronze, and it is all that rang the night of the fire.
Let it ring again, not melt.
They won't touch it.

outro.text: I heard it ring just now: once, in thanks. You did that.

quests.name: A Second Edge
quests.objective: Face Kurogane again, with nothing held back

intro.text: You beat the man I was. I would meet the one I am now.
No tricks. No sparing. A second edge.
Then no sparing.

outro.text: Hm. Yes. That is what the edge is for. Walk well, shinobi.

quests.name: Sluice Gears
quests.objective: Recover the sluice gears swept down the spillway

intro.text: Four bronze gears from the sluice, swept down the spillway when the water jumped.
Without them the gates only open by hand. By two dozen hands.
Four gears. Spillway first.

outro.text: Cold, wet, and perfect. The gates will turn with a finger. I could kiss you. I won't. Thank you.

quests.name: The Flood Gang
quests.objective: Break the gang that sells 'flood insurance' below the dam

intro.text: A gang below the dam claims they'll keep the gates shut for a fee. Odd, since they are the ones who open them.
Three bands, then.

outro.text: The valley will sleep soundly, and the gates will stay honest.

quests.name: A Keeper's Test
quests.objective: Spar with Chiyo to prove the dam is safe in your hands

intro.text: My grandfather tested every apprentice at the dam. Hands first, words later.
You've held the dam once. Show me you could hold it twice.
Let's find out.

outro.text: Steady feet. The dam is lucky to know you.

quests.name: Frostbitten Snares
quests.objective: Collect the scouts' old snares before something steps in them

intro.text: The scouts left snares all over the road last winter, and the snow has since buried them.
Five I know about. A wolf in one would be bad. A traveller, worse.
I'll dig them out.

outro.text: Every one. You've saved a leg or two. Probably wolves'.

quests.name: Wolves of White
quests.objective: Beat back the white-cloaked hunters stalking the road

intro.text: White-cloaked hunters took the road after the thaw. They call themselves wolves.
They're not as wolfish as they think. But they are good.
Good enough to be worth my time.

outro.text: The road is ours again. I'll buy the first round, once I find a tavern.

quests.name: Feathers of the Five
quests.objective: Find the wind-borne feathers the summit sheds

intro.text: The summit sheds a feather for each wind that crosses it. Five winds, five feathers.
They don't fall. They blow about. You'll have to chase.
I like a chase.

outro.text: All five. Now I can finish the cloak. Don't ask how long I've been at it.

quests.name: The Hermit's Spar
quests.objective: Meet the hermit in the open, on the summit's terms

intro.text: A hermit does not retire from the blade, only from the world.
Humour an old man. Four winds against you. The fifth is mine.
Then I'll bring all five.

outro.text: Ha! Still got a bit of gale in the bones. Take the summit's blessing.
